title: GPU nodepool failsafe Terraform module: ASG/Karpenter interop, staged upgrades, and health-check policies
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module for GPU nodepools in Private (VPC) that provides a robust failsafe for autoscaling across ASG and Karpenter provisioning modes. The module must support: blue/green-style nodepool swaps (non-destructive replacement), staged instance refreshes, preflight capacity and driver-compatibility checks, per-node health hooks for ASG and Karpenter eviction-safe drains, and a fallback policy to route low-priority traffic to CPU-backed pools when GPU capacity or drivers fail. This is intended to reduce downtime during driver upgrades, kernel updates, or capacity anomalies and to standardize upgrade tooling across customer on-prem and VPC deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes variables to configure: desired/target GPU capacity, max surge, max unavailable, driver_version pin, provisioning_mode (asg|karpenter), and healthcheck_tolerances.
A staged upgrade path exists: preflight -> canary replacement (5% nodes) -> staggered roll -> verify -> finalize; can be executed via CLI or CI pipeline with idempotent Terraform apply runs.
ASG health hooks integrated: autoscaling suspend/resume and lifecycle hooks call a Lambda (or webhook) that coordinates replacement and registers node health to Console for tracing.
Karpenter integration: provisioner annotations support drain hooks and node taints; module emits Kubernetes manifests (K8s provider) for safe cordon/drain with GPU driver readiness probes.
Automated preflight check fails the run with clear errors if GPU driver mismatch or insufficient spare capacity in the target AZs.

End-to-end smoke tests validating: pod scheduling on replacement nodes, KV cache warmup time within SLO, and graceful preemption/fallback to CPU nodes under simulated GPU failures. Results documented in the PR and test dashboard.
Module code coverage and CI plan exist; a GitHub PR implements module and is merged with at least two reviewer approvals.
tasks: Design module API: variables, outputs, and SNS/Lambda hook contracts
Implement ASG path: autoscaling group template, lifecycle hooks, health check scripts
Implement Karpenter path: provisioner CRD templating, taints/taints handling, drain hook manifest
Driver preflight: implement Terraform null_resource + script to verify driver bundles and nvcc for AMI images
Upgrade orchestration: implement canary/stage flags and terraform workspaces/target plans example
Health check integration: wire to Console observability events and create runbook snippets
Fallback policy: implement node selectors/taints and example routing policy to CPU pool
E2E tests: create Terraform test harness and k8s job to validate scheduling & KV cache warmup
Documentation: README, examples (ASG-only, Karpenter-only, hybrid), and recommended CI job config
Create GitHub PR and request security review and infra team signoff

operational_notes: When performing upgrades in customer VPCs, run preflight with --dry-run to validate AZ-level spare capacity. If preflight fails, do not proceed; open an automatic support ticket and surface diagnostic bundle including AMI IDs, node counts, and driver checks. For Karpenter, ensure nodeTemplate matches driver-compatible AMI/ENI settings before triggering canary.
